page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.s2 server family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and runs on the KVM hypervisor. The instance features 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores, with 1.0 thread per core, meaning hyper-threading is not enabled. It is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage for operating system and application data. There are no integrated GPUs or hardware accelerators, and it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. A key technical constraint is the absence of advanced CPU instruction sets; flags for Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), cryptography acceleration (AES, SHA_NI), and bit manipulation (BMI2, FMA) are not available.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.s2.xlarge offers an entry-level, dedicated hardware profile with a balanced resource allocation. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without the resource contention typical of shared-core instances. This configuration is suitable for lightweight general-purpose workloads, such as basic web serving, small application servers, development environments, and low-traffic database instances that do not require specialized vector processing or local storage performance.
